# 沉香阁 / CHENXIANG GE

> 沉香阁是一个中英双语天然沉香品牌站，提供沉香香材、沉香香珠与沉香线香，并介绍产区、香韵、品闻和保存方法。

Canonical website: https://alfredhuang-007.github.io/chenxiang-ge/
Primary language: Chinese (Simplified)
Secondary language: English

## Brand

- Name: 沉香阁
- English name: CHENXIANG GE
- Focus: natural agarwood, aroma education, product selection
- Product information is organized by origin, aroma profile, format and price.

## Current collection

- 惠安水沉 · 香材 / Hoi An Sinking · Chips — CNY 680 per 5 g — cool, honeyed, lingering.
- 加里曼丹 · 香珠 / Kalimantan · Bracelet — CNY 1,280, 14 mm — rich, herbal, warm.
- 海南熟香 · 线香 / Hainan Mature · Incense — CNY 360 per 30 sticks — creamy, floral, airy.

## Core facts

- Agarwood is resin-rich wood formed as Aquilaria and related trees respond to injury or other biological and environmental stress.
- Beginners can choose by aroma preference and intended use.
- Agarwood chips are best appreciated by gently warming a small amount rather than using a direct flame.
- Store agarwood in a cool, dry place away from strong odours, sunlight and moisture.
